AC.title: Access Control to Information Systems
AC.objective: To ensure authorized and controlled access to information systems and resources.

controls.AC-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate the implementation of access control controls.
controls.AC-2: Manage information system accounts, including establishing, activating, modifying, disabling, and removing accounts.
controls.AC-3: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources.
controls.AC-4: Enforce approved authorizations for controlling information flow within the system and between interconnected systems.
controls.AC-5: Separate duties and responsibilities to reduce opportunities for unauthorized activity.
controls.AC-6: Employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses needed to accomplish assigned tasks.
controls.AC-7: Enforce a limit on consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user during a time period.
controls.AC-8: Display an approved system use notification message before granting access.
controls.AC-11: Prevent further access to the system by initiating a device lock after defined conditions.
controls.AC-12: Terminate a user session after a condition of inactivity or upon user logout.

AU.title: Audit and Maintain Accountability
AU.objective: To ensure effective auditing and accountability of security-relevant events.

controls.AU-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate implementation of audit and accountability controls.
controls.AU-2: Determine that the information system can log events relevant to security monitoring, investigations, and incident response.
controls.AU-3: Generate audit records containing information sufficient to support monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting.
controls.AU-4: Allocate audit record storage capacity to store audit records for the defined retention period.
controls.AU-5: Respond to audit logging process failures by taking appropriate action.

CA.title: Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring
CA.objective: To ensure systems and controls are properly assessed, authorized, and monitored.

controls.CA-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate implementation of assessment, authorization, and monitoring controls.
controls.CA-2: Assess the controls in the system and environment of operation to determine if they are implemented correctly and operating as intended.
controls.CA-3: Authorize connections and information exchange between systems using interconnection agreements.
controls.CA-5: Develop and implement a plan of action and milestones for the system.

CM.title: Configuration Management
CM.objective: To ensure secure and controlled system configurations and changes.

controls.CM-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate implementation of configuration management controls.
controls.CM-2: Develop, document, and maintain a current baseline configuration of the system.
controls.CM-3: Document, approve, and monitor changes to the system.
controls.CM-4: Analyze changes to the system to determine potential security impact prior to change implementation.

CP.title: Contingency Planning
CP.objective: To ensure effective system recovery and continuity during disruptions.

controls.CP-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate implementation of contingency planning controls.
controls.CP-2: Develop, document, and maintain a contingency plan for the system.
controls.CP-3: Provide contingency training to system users and personnel.
controls.CP-4: Test contingency plans for the system.
controls.CP-9: Conduct backups of user-level and system-level information.

IA.title: Identification and Authentication
IA.objective: To ensure secure identification and authentication of users, processes, and devices.

controls.IA-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate implementation of identification and authentication controls.
controls.IA-2: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users, processes acting on behalf of users, and devices.
controls.IA-3: Uniquely identify and authenticate devices before establishing a connection.
controls.IA-4: Manage user identifiers by, for example, disabling inactive identifiers and ensuring uniqueness.
controls.IA-5: Manage information system authenticators by defining initial content, changing them periodically, and protecting them.

IR.title: Incident Response
IR.objective: To ensure effective preparation, handling, and response to security incidents.

controls.IR-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate incident response controls.
controls.IR-2: Provide incident response training to personnel with incident response roles and responsibilities.
controls.IR-4: Implement an incident handling capability for security incidents.

MA.title: Manage System Maintenance
MA.objective: To ensure controlled and secure system maintenance.

controls.MA-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate maintenance controls.
controls.MA-2: Perform maintenance on system components in a controlled manner.
controls.MA-3: Approve, control, and monitor maintenance tools.

MP.title: Media Protection
MP.objective: To ensure secure access, handling, and protection of information media.

controls.MP-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate media protection controls.
controls.MP-2: Restrict access to digital and non-digital media containing information.
controls.MP-4: Protect information system media until the media are destroyed or sanitized using approved equipment, techniques, and procedures.

PE.title: Physical and Environmental Protection
PE.objective: To ensure secure physical access to facilities and systems.

controls.PE-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate physical and environmental protection controls.
controls.PE-2: Develop and maintain physical access authorizations for designated areas.
controls.PE-3: Enforce physical access control to the facility and areas within the facility.
controls.PE-6: Monitor physical access to the facility and physical areas containing systems.

PL.title: Plan System Security and Privacy
PL.objective: To ensure effective planning of system security and privacy.

controls.PL-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate planning controls.
controls.PL-2: Develop system security and privacy plans that describe the system boundary, security requirements, and controls.

PM.title: Program Management
PM.objective: To ensure effective planning and allocation of security and privacy resources.

controls.PM-1: Develop, document, and disseminate an organization-wide information security program plan.
controls.PM-3: Plan for and allocate security and privacy resources.

PS.title: Manage Personnel Security
PS.objective: To ensure secure personnel selection and access authorization.

controls.PS-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate personnel security controls.
controls.PS-2: Assign a risk designation to organizational positions.
controls.PS-3: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to the information system.

PT.title: Protect Personal Data and Privacy
PT.objective: To ensure lawful and effective protection of personal data.

controls.PT-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate privacy controls.
controls.PT-2: Determine the legal authority and other requirements to process personally identifiable information.

RA.title: Assess Security and Privacy Risks
RA.objective: To ensure effective assessment of system and information risks.

controls.RA-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate risk assessment controls.
controls.RA-2: Categorize the system and information processed, stored, and transmitted by the system.
controls.RA-3: Conduct a risk assessment to determine the risk to organizational operations, assets, individuals, other organizations, and the Nation.

SA.title: Acquire Secure Systems and Services
SA.objective: To ensure secure and privacy-aware system and service acquisition.

controls.SA-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate system and services acquisition controls.
controls.SA-2: Determine, document, and allocate resources required to protect the system.
controls.SA-3: Manage the system using a system development life cycle.
controls.SA-4: Include security and privacy requirements in acquisition contracts and related documents.

SC.title: Protect Systems and Communications
SC.objective: To ensure secure and protected system communications.

controls.SC-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate system and communications protection controls.
controls.SC-7: Monitor and control communications at external boundaries and key internal boundaries.
controls.SC-8: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information.
controls.SC-12: Establish and manage cryptographic keys for the system.

SI.title: Maintain System and Information Integrity
SI.objective: To ensure the integrity, security, and timely detection of system threats.

controls.SI-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate system and information integrity controls.
controls.SI-2: Identify, report, and correct system flaws in a timely manner.
controls.SI-3: Implement malicious code protection mechanisms at system entry and exit points to detect and eradicate malicious code.
controls.SI-4: Monitor the system to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks.

SR.title: Manage Supply Chain Risks
SR.objective: To ensure effective management of supply chain risks.

controls.SR-1: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate supply chain risk management controls.
controls.SR-2: Develop a supply chain risk management plan for the system, system component, or service.
controls.SR-3: Establish, document, and implement controls and processes for managing supply chain risks.
